title: Fabrication, Supply, Installation and Commissioning of Distribution Panel for 2 Nos. 40KVA Gensets at Pulicat Lighthouse and DGPS Station under Chennai Directorate.
summary: E-tender (two-cover) for fabrication, supply, installation and commissioning of a distribution panel for two 40 kVA generator sets at Pulicat Lighthouse and DGPS Station, Tamil Nadu (Chennai Directorate).

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Chennai

sites.name: Pulicat Lighthouse and DGPS Station
sites.work: Fabrication, supply, installation and commissioning of distribution panel for 2 nos. 40 kVA gensets

scope.item: Fabrication, Supply, Installation and Commissioning of Distribution Panel for 2 Nos. 40KVA Gensets

money.notes: Estimated cost including GST. EMD by DD/FDR of any nationalised bank in favour of The Director of Lighthouses and Lightships, Chennai, payable at Chennai, valid 90 days from technical bid opening. Tender fee Rs 500 (non-refundable) by DD. Tender fee and EMD exempted for valid MSME/NSIC certificate.

eligibility: OEMs or their authorised agents, or appropriate class contractors registered with CPWD/State PWD/Railways/MES/BSNL or other State/Central Govt/PSU/autonomous bodies, having experience in the work
specs: Distribution panel for 2 nos. 40 kVA gensets
notes: Section 1 NIT only; no file number, BOQ or panel specification. Download, bid and EMD/fee submission 25.03.2024 15:00 to 08.04.2024 14:00; pre-bid 02.04.2024 15:00; technical bid opening 09.04.2024 14:30. Hindi tender-fee row repeats the EMD wording (Rs 18,900) while English states Rs 500 (English value recorded). Bid validity not stated.
